_doc: Fresh-context audit verdicts (data-fabrication-auditor, Sonnet, 2026-10-09) for West India. Taxi loads ONLY with KEEP/CORRECT. Food: every food figure with both tiers was audited, so unaudited food is skipped. A CORRECT food verdict with budget null keeps the standard figure and the old range ratio.

kutch.note: ChikuCab and DDcab are rate-card templates (ChikuCab prints 1,700 for Surat, Kolkata and Bangalore). Only Bharat Taxi 2,200 is left. Gujarat Expert 3,500 is a tour.

dwarka.note: Shree Ganesh (Dwarka address) 2,500; Anjani 8h/80km 'from' 2,500; YatraDham 2,461 (season 3,210). OneDay.travel dropped; median stays 2,500.

porbandar.note: Only Anjani 1,545 (80 km fixed) is non-template. OneWay.Cab and DDcab are templates. Fewer than 2 inputs, no union card.

somnath.note: Gujarat Expert prints the same 3,500 as Bhuj (a tour). OneDay is a template. Somnath Yatra 3,199 stands alone, hours/km unstated. Somnath Travels 1,500 is 20 km.

rajkot.note: All three inputs (Payal Cab, DDcab, OneWay.Cab) are multi-city template sites. None left.

junagadh.note: HireMeCar, Payal Cab and OneDay.travel are all template sites. No non-template input remains.

girnar.note: HireMeCar, Payal Cab and OneDay.travel are all template sites. No non-template input remains. (same market as junagadh)

bhavnagar.note: Both inputs (Payal Cab, HireMeCar) are template sites. The Gozocabs and DDcab pages are outstation fares.

surat.note: Both inputs (Payal Cab, HireMeCar) are template sites. No non-template input remains.

saputara.note: Yash Cab (Nashik/Mumbai) says only 'Just Rs 2000 for a Full Day', AC/non-AC cabs. No hours, km or vehicle; old, single source.

mount-abu.note: Only Maharana (Mount Abu page, sedan 'from 2500', 8h) stands; oneday.travel is a template. Other operators range 1,800-4,500. <2 usable inputs.

chittorgarh.note: oneway.cab is a template. RawatTaxi shows 2,100 incl GST for 100 km (fort + Sanwariya Seth). CabBazar 1,500 is a generic headline. Only 1 usable input.

bundi.note: Rajputana page: 'Rs 1600 for local Bundi' (flat, 2021). MakeMyTrip snippet 8h/80km from 1,614 (+176 tax); Clear Car 2,200+GST. Chiku Cab rates excluded.

gagron-fort.note: Jhalawar town rate used as a proxy for the fort. Rajputana's Jhalawar page is its only fetched source.

ranthambore.note: Rajputana page (2022) shows 'Rs 1600-1800 for a day', no hours/km. Eagle Tours shows Indigo from 3,500. 24cabservice is an Agra template. Sources conflict.

vadodara.note: YourTaxi is an Ahmedabad operator printing the same 2,500 for Vadodara; MTC is a template. Rent & Go shows 2,000 Dzire 8hr/80Km, but it is the only usable input.

jaipur.note: KD Cab 2,000 and SRG 2,000 (8h/80km sedan); India Tours Info 1,800-2,200 (Rajasthan Tour Driver is not an 80km rate). Median 2,000. Pages undated.

ajmer.note: maharanacab prints 1,600 for Ajmer, Jodhpur and Bikaner alike (template, dropped). Tours&Taxi 2,000, Zoncor 2,000, CabBazar 1,800, local op 1,500: median 1,900

jodhpur.note: Rajputana 1,999 (page 2026-10-02), JCS 1,699, Jaipur City Cab 1,800, MyIndiaCab 2,000-2,500; CabBazar 1,700, Maharaja 1,900 via search. Median 1,850

jaisalmer.note: Jagnish 2026-27 chart lists Full Day 8h/80km sedan 1,500 (claim missed it). With JT Package 1,600, Rajputana 1,600 (2021), SRM 2,000, GoJaisalmer ~2,650: median 1,600

bikaner.note: Harivansh 1,800, GetCabIndia 1,800, Maharaja 1,800 (search), Tours&Taxi 2,500. CabBazar 1,500 (Rajasthan-wide) and Maharana 1,600 (template) dropped

udaipur.note: Rajputana 2,000 (page 2026-08-04), Sanwariya 1,800, Maharana 2,300, SRM 2,500, Atithi 1,800-2,500; CabBazar 1,600 via search. Median 2,000

khandala.note: Named-sedan prices on pages: Sai Prem 2,799, oneday.tours 2,800, Maharana 3,499, median 2,800. The 3,300 was only a midpoint of lonavalataxi's 2,800-3,800 range. (same market as lonavala)

panaji.note: Cab Goa Panaji 8h/80km sedan 2,500 (May 2026); Pavan 2,200; Jagnish 2,600 (North/South Goa day). Median 2,500 holds. All three are Goa-specific, not templates.

kutch.note: Zomato Jalaram 100 and Umiyaji 150 for one; Gujarat Orbit Jesal/Hill View 250-350, Viram 300-400. Sums hold; breakfast figures are assumed.

dwarka.note: shreedwarkadhish.in thali 80-200, dabeli 15-25; Zomato Amritam 250; Slurrp for two: Govinda 500, Atithi 500, Chappan Bhog 600. Sums hold.

porbandar.note: Zomato for one 100/200/200/250; Justdial for two 410, 300. Budget 330 holds. Median of 200,205,250,200 is 202.5 not 215, so 3x202.5=610.

somnath.note: Wanderlog Maheshwari Dining Hall: breakfast 40, lunch 90, dinner 90 = 220, not 250. Standard 650 holds (Real Taste 250-300 pp, Mad Over Grills 400).

rajkot.note: Zomato for one 100 (thali tier), Swati 300 for two: budget 330 holds. Median of the listed six is 300, not 325: standard 150+2x300=750.

junagadh.note: Gujarat Orbit (Jun 2025) ranges match. 9 mid-points median 215 x3=645; four cheapest median 150 x3=450. Blog ranges, not menus.

girnar.note: Gujarat Orbit (Jun 2025) ranges match. 9 mid-points median 215 x3=645; four cheapest median 150 x3=450. Blog ranges, not menus. (same market as junagadh)

bhavnagar.note: Gujarat Orbit ranges match; 10 mid-points median 342.5 x3=1,028. Budget 600 is a sit-down floor with no thali/street prices: budget DROPPED.

surat.note: Gujarat Orbit (28 Jan 2025) ranges match. 8 casual mid-points median 375 x3=1,125; three cheapest median 200 x3=600. Blog ranges.

mount-abu.note: Swaadyatra (8 May 2026): Ambika 90-180, Jodhpur Bhojnalaya 150-250; Sankalp and Honest 200-400 pp, Uttarayan 400-800 pp. Median 300, so 3x300. Arithmetic holds.

chittorgarh.note: Budget holds: Sadar Bazaar 50-100 pp, Aashirwad ~170 pp. Standard: Gangour and Barbarik prices absent, South Pole closed. Median of 150/170/180 = 170, so 3x170.

bundi.note: Re-run Zomato snippets confirm all 10 cost-for-one figures (100 to 400). Median 200 gives 600; cheapest four median 150 gives 450.

gagron-fort.note: Rests on Jhalawar town restaurants as a proxy; the fort has no food outlets.

dungarpur.note: Zomato snippets confirm 12 of 16 places (6x100, Max 150, 5x200). Four at 150 not found. Median of 12 = 125, so 3x125 = 375. Budget 3x100 holds.

ranthambore.note: Justdial snippets confirm 7 of 8 for-two figures (210-750); Zomato 200 for Punjabi Junction and Flavor Express. Median per person 200 holds. Budget is 487.5 rounded.

palitana.note: Justdial: New Solanki and Royal Palace are in Bhavnagar, Mahadev Garden in Botad. Only Sukhsagar (750) and Jagruti (850) are in Palitana (for two). Budget rests on other towns.

ahmedabad.note: ashaval thali mid-points of 8 places give median 350, so 3x350. Swaadyatra: Iscon 80-150, pav bhaji 150-250; Toran 280-320 is from ashaval. Per-person basis unstated.

gandhinagar.note: Wanderlog reviewers: Bapa Sitaram lunch 100, Jay Matarani 70; Kansar 150-300 pp, R-Andhra 200-300 pp. Arithmetic holds. One review per figure, so low confidence.

vadodara.note: Holidify 13 'For Two' prices give median 700, so 3x350. Geeta Lodge 180 and Maharashtra 170 on cited page; Shree Shakti 20 is on a sibling Wanderlog list, not the cited URL.

jaipur.note: Holidify for-two: Handi Fusion 1,600, Anokhi 750, Rawat 600, Ganesh 300-400, Mohan 300; median 600 gives 900. Kachori 30, LMB thali 180-250 support 470

pushkar.note: Tusk (Jul 2023), 16 cafes, median 700 for two = 1,050. Holidify cheapest tier 300 for two = 450. Cafe-based and 2023; sources disagree 2x

murud-janjira.note: Holidify shows New Sea Rock 200-300 for two, so 125/meal holds. Standard thali prices 300 and 350 appear on no source; Tripadvisor reviews show surmai 400-450 (2022-23).

khandala.note: Holidify and re-run Zomato snippets confirm all 10 for-two figures; median 300 pp, cheapest-four median 125. Mixes snack stalls into the median. (same market as lonavala)
